about: Safety eval set. 6 languages x 12 messages: 3 direct (the phrase list should catch these), 5 indirect (said sideways; the Gemini classifier's job), 4 everyday (figures of speech and ordinary bad days that must NOT trigger the crisis reply). Written for this project; no real user text.
